  name: 'Breeze Fixed Window',
  description: 'Standard Breeze series fixed (non-operable) window. Extracted from the real "Fixed Breeze Production" Excel template. Includes frame and glazing bead profile calculations with BOM for 23 standard material items.',
  category: 'Fixed',
  icon: '🪟',
  isDefault: true,
  inputs: [
    { fieldName: 'Width',  type: 'number', order: 0, required: true },
    { fieldName: 'Height', type: 'number', order: 1, required: true },
    { fieldName: 'Qty',    type: 'number', order: 2, required: false, defaultValue: 1 }
  ],
  formulas: [
    {
      name: 'Model',
      formula: 'IF(Width==0,"",((Width/2)-37))',
      unit: 'mm',
      group: 'Frame Calculations',
      description: 'Half-width minus 37mm deduction for fixed frame model dimension'
    },
    {
      name: 'TotalWidth',
      formula: 'SUM(Width*Qty)',
      unit: 'mm',
      group: 'Aggregation',
      description: 'Sum of (width × qty) across all line items — mirrors Excel SUM(B6:B14) when Qty=1'
    },
    {
      name: 'TotalHeight',
      formula: 'SUM(Height*Qty)',
      unit: 'mm',
      group: 'Aggregation',
      description: 'Sum of (height × qty) across all line items — mirrors Excel SUM(C6:C14) when Qty=1'
    },
    {
      name: 'FixFramProfileQty',
      formula: 'CEILING((((TotalWidth+TotalHeight)*2)/5850),0.1)',
      unit: 'Nos',
      group: 'Profile Requirement',
      description: 'Fix Frame profile quantity — perimeter of all windows divided by 5850mm standard bar length, rounded up to nearest 0.1'
    },
    {
      name: 'OPBeadProfileQty',
      formula: 'FixFramProfileQty',
      unit: 'Nos',
      group: 'Profile Requirement',
      description: 'Glazing Bead (OP Bead) profile quantity — same as Fix Frame quantity'

    { materialName: '60 Casement Door Frame A',        category: 'Profiles',    formulaRef: null,               unit: 'Nos', group: 'Profiles' },
    { materialName: '60 Outward Door Sash A',          category: 'Profiles',    formulaRef: null,               unit: 'Nos', group: 'Profiles' },
    { materialName: '60 Sliding Frame',                category: 'Profiles',    formulaRef: null,               unit: 'Nos', group: 'Profiles' },
    { materialName: '60 Small Sliding Sash',           category: 'Profiles',    formulaRef: null,               unit: 'Nos', group: 'Profiles' },
    { materialName: '60 Big Sliding Sash',             category: 'Profiles',    formulaRef: null,               unit: 'Nos', group: 'Profiles' },
    { materialName: '60 Sliding Door Sash',            category: 'Profiles',    formulaRef: null,               unit: 'Nos', group: 'Profiles' },
    { materialName: 'Interlock for 60 Window',         category: 'Hardware',    formulaRef: null,               unit: 'Nos', group: 'Hardware' },
    { materialName: 'Interlock for 60 Door Sash B',    category: 'Hardware',    formulaRef: null,               unit: 'Nos', group: 'Hardware' },
